settings.title: What's included
settings.content: A four-sided vertical bar necklace and a matching flat-band coordinates ring, each arranged around the place you choose.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter one verified coordinate pair or customize the ring and necklace separately. 2. Review every active necklace side, the ring line, and the measured ring size. 3. Check both submitted engravings in the cart before checkout.

settings.atc_label: Add to cart — free engraving on every piece
